runs.title: How do you cancel ChatGPT Plus?
runs.prompt: A user wants to cancel their ChatGPT Plus subscription. Find the exact official steps to cancel, from OpenAI's own sites.
runs.answer: Per OpenAI's official help article "Canceling your ChatGPT subscription" (help.openai.com/en/articles/7232927), cancel on the platform where you subscribed. If you bought Plus on the web (chatgpt.com): sign in to ChatGPT, open your account menu → Settings → Billing, then under "Cancel plan" select "Cancel." If you subscribed via Apple App Store: iPhone/iPad Settings → your name → Subscriptions → ChatGPT → Cancel Subscription → confirm. If via Google Play: Google Play Store app → Subscriptions → ChatGPT → Cancel subscription (or on the web at play.google.com/store/account/subscriptions). Self-service ChatGPT Business: account menu → Workspace settings → Billing → Manage plan → Cancel subscription. Cancel at least 24 hours before your next billing date; paid features stay until the end of the current period, and canceling does not auto-refund prior charges. Uninstalling the app or (for Apple/Google) deleting your ChatGPT account does not cancel the subscription.
